proposal.summary: OpenSC contains a heap-based out-of-bounds read in pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package when parsing a malicious ASN.1 smart card package; incorrect remaining-length calculation due to a moved starting pointer can lead to OOB read and ASAN-detected crash; potential info leak or further impact possible.
proposal.cwe_quote: This security flaw cause a buffer overrun vulnerability in pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package. The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context.

AV.quote: The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context.

C.quote: Further info leak or more damage is possible.

A.quote: In cases where ASAN is enabled while compiling this causes a crash.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the vulnerable OpenSC version and test a crafted ASN.1 package against pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package to reproduce the heap OOB read; create a minimal PoC and determine whether info disclosure beyond crash is possible; prepare patch to correctly compute remaining length and add bounds checks.

evidence_quotes.quote: This security flaw cause a buffer overrun vulnerability in pkcs15 cardos_have_verifyrc_package.

evidence_quotes.claim: Attack vector: attacker supplies malformed package
evidence_quotes.quote: The attacker can supply a smart card package with malformed ASN1 context.

evidence_quotes.claim: Root cause: wrong remaining length calculation due to moved pointer
evidence_quotes.quote: The cardos_have_verifyrc_package function scans the ASN1 buffer for 2 tags, where remaining length is wrongly caculated due to moved starting pointer.
This leads to possible heap-based buffer oob read.
In cases where ASAN is enabled while compiling this causes a crash.
Further info leak or more damage is possible.
